name: Deformable 3D Gaussian Splatting
definition: A dynamic reconstruction method that uses an MLP to implicitly fit a deformation field. It inputs positional-encoded Gaussian position and timestep t to the MLP, which outputs offsets for position, rotation, and scaling.
summary: Deformable 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstructs dynamic scenes by learning static Gaussians and using an implicit MLP to model time-dependent deformations, distinguishing itself from mesh-based methods.
